scene: Outside the New York Stock Exchange, 29 Oct 1929: packed anxious crowd, newsboys waving papers, police, cars
show: October 1929. Wall Street.|People here are buying stocks|with just 10% down.
say: October, nineteen twenty-nine. Wall Street. People here are buying stocks with just ten percent down.

scene: Inside a broker's office: ticker tape spilling, clerks shouting, chalkboard prices being wiped
show: The other 90%? Borrowed.|So when prices crashed...|many lost everything.
say: The other ninety percent? Borrowed. So when prices crashed... many lost everything.

scene: Calm 1920s Boston office: ordinary people at a counter, clerk handing over a certificate, warm light
show: But in Boston, a new kind of fund|let ordinary people in...|and out, any time, at the real value.
say: But in Boston, a new kind of fund let ordinary people in... and out, any time, at the real value.

scene: Same presenter in a bright modern city street, morning, people walking
show: Today? Start your own fund with $10.|Own it outright. See every holding.|Next stop... 1976.
say: Today? Start your own fund with ten dollars. Own it outright. See every holding. Next stop... nineteen seventy-six.
